description: Covera builds AI agents for insurance brokers. Our ready-to-use agents take over the day-to-day servicing work: submission intake, carrier quoting, quote comparison, claims handling, past-due collections, and account rounding. That means brokers can spend their time advising and selling clients instead of doing data entry. We work with agencies of every size and connect natively to the tools they already use.
name: Covera

description: Allia is the first full-stack, AI-native clinical group for mental health. We bring independent practices into one national clinical group that can deliver, measure, and improve care at scale - 600+ providers (350+ therapists, 200+ nurses & doctors, 30+ psychologists) across 70 sites in 32 states, plus telehealth nationwide. Every clinician runs on a single intelligent system of record. And, that intelligence coupled with scale unlocks what no single practice could achieve alone.
name: Allia Health
one_liner: Clinically Integrated Group for Mental Health

description: Studio is a simulation lab studying how humans and societies respond to new ideas, and is building the first software models that can accurately predict that response. Instead of creating digital twins of survey respondents, Studio builds live market models of interconnected audience segments from real, traceable consumer-behavior evidence. Our predictions match live KPI outcomes like revenue and sentiment with over 95% accuracy for large consumer-facing brands.
name: Studio
